VARIABLE.NAME: SchizophreniaEstablished
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician-confirmed schizophrenia. No means assessed and not confirmed; absent diagnostic data stay unobserved.
time_window=Current dated review; retain relevant medication and adherence history intervals separately
missingness_policy=No unrecorded input may be mapped to No, Absent, Adequate, Undecided or Uncertain
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after graph and measurement review; require documented data or elicitation

VARIABLE.NAME: LAIPreference
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Current informed preference after discussion. PrefersOral means preference without explicit refusal of LAI; explicit refusal is DeclinesLAI. Undecided means assessed ambivalence, not missing documentation. Preference is not consent to a specific injection.
time_window=Current dated review; retain relevant medication and adherence history intervals separately
missingness_policy=No unrecorded input may be mapped to No, Absent, Adequate, Undecided or Uncertain
parameter_requirement=4 prior entries after graph and measurement review; require documented data or elicitation

VARIABLE.NAME: AdherenceHistory
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician assessment of antipsychotic adherence history using dated patient report, dispensing and administration records and collateral information where available. Uncertain means assessed uncertainty, not an unreviewed chart; Adequate is the assessed alternative to poor or uncertain. Local assessment window and criteria must be agreed.
time_window=Current dated review; retain relevant medication and adherence history intervals separately
missingness_policy=No unrecorded input may be mapped to No, Absent, Adequate, Undecided or Uncertain
parameter_requirement=3 prior entries after graph and measurement review; require documented data or elicitation

VARIABLE.NAME: AdditionalDiscussionContext
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician identifies a contextual reason for LAI discussion: oral nonresponse with possible unrecognized treatment gaps; care transition with concern about future adherence; early illness or limited treatment awareness or substance use with adherence concerns; repeated hospitalizations or emergency visits prompting review. Record which reason and dates. These are discussion prompts, not proof of nonadherence. Absent means assessed and none identified.
time_window=Current dated review; retain relevant medication and adherence history intervals separately
missingness_policy=No unrecorded input may be mapped to No, Absent, Adequate, Undecided or Uncertain
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after graph and measurement review; require documented data or elicitation

VARIABLE.NAME: SameDrugOralExperience
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=For the specific candidate antipsychotic, prior oral efficacy and tolerability are both supported, either has a concern, or supporting evidence has not been established after review. Concern takes precedence. NotEstablished is a reviewed treatment-history state, not missing input. Oral trial is typical guidance, not a universal hard contraindication.
time_window=Current dated review; retain relevant medication and adherence history intervals separately
missingness_policy=No unrecorded input may be mapped to No, Absent, Adequate, Undecided or Uncertain
parameter_requirement=3 prior entries after graph and measurement review; require documented data or elicitation

VARIABLE.NAME: PriorNeurolepticMalignantSyndrome
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Documented history of neuroleptic malignant syndrome. No means assessed absence of history; missing history remains unobserved. This does not assess current NMS or replace urgent medical assessment.
time_window=Current dated review; retain relevant medication and adherence history intervals separately
missingness_policy=No unrecorded input may be mapped to No, Absent, Adequate, Undecided or Uncertain
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after graph and measurement review; require documented data or elicitation

VARIABLE.NAME: ProductPlanReviewed
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician/pharmacist has reviewed the specific candidate and current local labeling, including LAI availability, any medication switch, dose conversion, oral overlap or loading, injection route/site/interval, preparation/storage, safe injection, product-specific observation/monitoring, and missed-dose instructions. Yes means reviewed, not approved or medically suitable.
time_window=Current dated review; retain relevant medication and adherence history intervals separately
missingness_policy=No unrecorded input may be mapped to No, Absent, Adequate, Undecided or Uncertain
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after graph and measurement review; require documented data or elicitation

VARIABLE.NAME: DeliveryBarriers
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Assessed access barriers: transportation, scheduling, childcare, cost/authorization, injection staffing/training, space or resources. Absent means no identified barrier after assessment, not evidence that treatment is safe.
time_window=Current dated review; retain relevant medication and adherence history intervals separately
missingness_policy=No unrecorded input may be mapped to No, Absent, Adequate, Undecided or Uncertain
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after graph and measurement review; require documented data or elicitation

VARIABLE.NAME: LAITreatmentStatus
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Current LAI use takes precedence; Previous means past LAI use without current use; Considering means never treated with an LAI. Clinical review concerns a specified candidate product; prior use of another agent does not establish candidate tolerability.
time_window=Current dated review; retain relevant medication and adherence history intervals separately
missingness_policy=No unrecorded input may be mapped to No, Absent, Adequate, Undecided or Uncertain
parameter_requirement=3 prior entries after graph and measurement review; require documented data or elicitation

VARIABLE.NAME: LAIGuidelineCriterion
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Confirmed schizophrenia AND (prefers LAI OR poor/uncertain adherence). NotEstablished is not a contraindication or a recommendation against LAI.
time_window=Current dated review; retain relevant medication and adherence history intervals separately
missingness_policy=No unrecorded input may be mapped to No, Absent, Adequate, Undecided or Uncertain

VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Proposed precedence: scope, explicit refusal, current/prior LAI context, then discussion opportunity. missingness_policy=No unrecorded input may be mapped to No, Absent, Adequate, Undecided or Uncertain
